stemMd: Hydrolysis of ethyl ethanoate under acidic conditions produces which pair of organic products?
explanationMd: An ester hydrolyses into the alcohol and carboxylic acid from which it can be formed. The ethyl group yields ethanol and the ethanoate part yields ethanoic acid.

distractorRationale.a: This would require different reactions and atom rearrangements.
distractorRationale.e: These do not account for the ester oxygen atoms.
distractorRationale.d: This is not ordinary ester hydrolysis.
distractorRationale.c: The acyl part becomes an acid, not a second alcohol.
